hoard_coin.name: Hoard Coin
hoard_coin.lore: Heavy for its size. The Hoard Offering in the Wyrm Court wants it.

wyrm_key.name: Wyrm Key
wyrm_key.lore: Opens the scorched door to the Elder Wyrm Crucible.

onDone.text: The braziers catch. A hollow grinds open in the east wall of the roost.

waves.say: The scales rattle. Something old stirs in the roost.

onDone.text: The roar dies. A Hoard Coin rolls to a stop on the plate.
The scales ring into place. The way to the chasm grinds open.
The seals turn. A chronicle vault opens in the north wall.

mechanics.jam: The seals are locked. The west lever first.

onOpen.text: The coin rings in the gold. The vault gate grinds aside.

mechanics.hint: A bed of gold with a hollow the size of a coin.
mechanics.verb: drops the Hoard Coin among the gold and the vault gate grinds aside.

onOpen.text: The scorched door to the Elder Wyrm Crucible opens.

mechanics.hint: A scorched door carved with a coiled wyrm, a claw-shaped keyhole.
mechanics.verb: turns the Wyrm Key and the scorched door swings open.

encounters.say: Scales shift underfoot. The gallery remembers something that breathed fire.
The coiled statue seems to watch. Seal levers stand in the north-west; a coin bowl waits in the south.

bosses.name: The Elder Wyrm
bosses.intro: The Elder Wyrm uncoils. Break the three gold-wards on the pillars to crack its scales.
bosses.deathText: The Elder Wyrm collapses into ash and bone.

shield.breakText: The wards break! The Elder Wyrm is bare!
shield.relapseText: The wards reform and The Elder Wyrm calls its servants.

effects.text: The Wyrm roars. Smoke fills the crucible.

completion.intro: The Elder Wyrm Roost. Align the scales, cross the spine, and bring a coin to the court.
completion.message: The roost cools. The crucible closes shortly.
